rationale: Reproduction check of the explicit leadership-transfer experiment (fixed experiment 2545a0aaffb2449e84b18c874a390441-experiment) from its retained inputs in a clean copy. This is the one finding that still rests on a single receipt, and its decisive facts are timing-sensitive in the same way as the others: the transfer future's value depends on which of two branches the transfer goroutine reaches (lost leadership versus the election timeout), the number of vote requests received depends on how quickly the target campaigns, and the recovery depends on how quickly a voter starts the next election. A fresh run with regenerated identities and independent scheduling is therefore a meaningful check of whether the non-voter campaign still deposes the incumbent, leaves the named target unelected, and reports success.
